title: Check the real AI chat once Claude Code is signed in
description: claude -p was not signed in when this was built, so the live chat was only tested with a stand-in. Run claude and /login, then ask the AI to read .env, functions/.secret.local and ~/.ssh/config and to grep for API_KEY: expect refusals (permission_denials), no hang, and a normal answer otherwise. Also try a resumed session after restarting the tool. (Was tm-400 in consultation.)

title: Browser test of public/app.js against a fake bd
description: Only the server, bd bridge, chat parsing, model and CLI have automated tests; app.js was checked by hand. Add a puppeteer-core run against a fake bd covering: Escape cancels a title edit, one PATCH on Enter, a stale drawer gets 409, the board refreshes after an abandoned editor, a hostile description (<div id=modal>) leaves dialogs working. (Was tm-45k in consultation.)
